//: risk-profiles/example.json -- every key of a risk profile, annotated. Documentation: risk-profiles/README.md.
//2: Merged over the config's `risk` section: objects key by key, lists replaced whole.
//3: Keys starting with // are comments, at any depth. Copy this file, keep what you need.

vars.//: {{name}} in any pattern below is replaced by this regex text before it is compiled.
vars.//compute_hosts: used by the built-in ssh_compute: the names of this cluster's compute nodes
vars.//shared_roots: a variable of this site's own, used by the rm_rf_shared override below

dangerous.//: Matched against "<command> <args>", case-insensitively. Built-in ids: README.md.
dangerous.//disable: built-in rules this site does not count
dangerous.//override: change any of label, severity, axis, pattern, gate of a built-in rule

pip_install.//: this site allows pip install --user on login: keep counting it, rank it lower

rm_rf_shared.//: the built-in matches any rm -rf; here only one aimed at shared storage counts.
rm_rf_shared.//gate: a new pattern drops the built-in gate; this one still always contains rm, so it may keep one
rm_rf_shared.label: rm -rf on shared storage

dangerous.//add: this site's own rules. id and pattern are required; the rest default.

add.label: apptainer/singularity build on a login node
rclone sync or copy on a login node
add.//gate: omitted: the rule then runs on every command line, which is always correct

secrets.//: Matched against the arguments only, case-sensitively. The value is never shown, and every
secrets.//1: pattern added or changed here is also masked in every command line the page shows.

login_compute.//: tool buckets (rc_dashboard/tool_buckets.py) counted as compute on a login node, and as bulk transfer

//sections: The Risk tab, top to bottom: which sections this cluster has, their titles, and which rules each shows.
//sections1: kind is login_compute, commands or credentials. rules: a list of ids, or "rest" for every enabled rule
//sections2: no other section of that kind lists. A rule no section shows is not counted; a kind no section uses is not computed.

sections.title: Data movement on a login node
